effects: Takes exactly `assets` USDT from the signer and sends it to the vault (Vault._deposit: safeTransferFrom(asset, caller, this, assets)).

Mints kmgpUSDT shares to `receiver`. The amount is computed when the tx runs from the vault's total assets, after the deposit fee (the fee rate is stored in the vault and was 0 at init). Shares can't be transferred, so `receiver` must be the signer unless someone holds SPENDER_ROLE.
The vault then puts the USDT into Morpho Gauntlet USDT Prime through a connector it delegatecalls. The vault holds that position for its share holders.
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit", with 1.03226 USDT to deposit, the share ticker kmgpUSDT and the address that gets the shares.

findings.title: deposit: intent "Deposit" names no asset or vault, and there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json deposit format: "intent": "Deposit" and no interpolatedIntent. Case 0: the signer sends 1032260 USDT into the Kiln Morpho Gauntlet USDT Prime vault.
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as "Deposit {assets} into Kiln Gauntlet USDT Prime for kmgpUSDT shares" and make the intent "Deposit USDT".

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares received is not shown, because the contract computes it.
findings.evidence: Vault.deposit: (_shares, _depositFeeAmount) = _previewDeposit(assets, _newTotalAssets, totalSupply()). There is no minShares parameter. Case 0: the signer received 1000001 kmgpUSDT, and the screen shows only the ticker.
findings.fix: Nothing in the calldata gives this amount. A label like "Receive kmgpUSDT shares (amount set by the vault)" would make that clear.

findings.title: deposit: a deposit fee read from storage can lower the shares minted, and the screen can't show it.
findings.evidence: Vault._previewDeposit: depositFeeAmount = assets.mulDiv($._depositFee, ...). The shares are minted on assets - depositFeeAmount, and FEE_MANAGER can change the fee (setDepositFee).

cases.notes: The reader got the USDT out right. For the kmgpUSDT in, the reader knew shares were coming but not how many, and the screen does not show a number.

effects: Takes USDT from the signer. The vault computes the amount from the share price plus the deposit fee (_previewMint), and nothing caps it in calldata.
The vault puts the USDT into the Morpho vault through its connector.
formats.shown: Intent "Mint", the word USDT as the deposit asset with no amount, the number of shares minted and the address that gets them.

findings.title: mint: how much USDT leaves the signer is not shown, and nothing in calldata caps it.
findings.evidence: Vault.mint: (_assets, _depositFeeAmount) = _previewMint(shares, ...), then _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, _assets, ...). The descriptor field 'Deposit asset' only shows the constant "USDT".
findings.fix: None possible with ERC-4626 mint. You could relabel to 'Pays in (amount set by vault)'.

findings.title: mint: intent "Mint" does not say USDT is taken from the signer to pay for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json mint format: "intent": "Mint" and no interpolatedIntent. Vault._deposit uses safeTransferFrom(asset, caller, ...).
findings.fix: Use the intent "Deposit USDT for shares" and an interpolatedIntent like "Mint {shares} by depositing USDT".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Burns kmgpUSDT shares from `owner`. The vault computes how many from `assets`, rounding up. Nothing in calldata caps it.
If the owner is not the signer, it spends the owner's share allowance given to the signer.
Takes USDT out of Morpho through the connector, then sends the USDT the vault gained to `receiver` (meant to be `assets`).
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw", the exact USDT amount, the recipient and the owner.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned from the owner are not shown, and nothing in calldata caps them.
findings.evidence: Vault.withdraw: _shares = _convertToShares(assets, Math.Rounding.Ceil, _accrueRewardFee(), totalSupply()), then _burn(owner, shares) in _withdraw.
findings.fix: None possible. You could label the screen to say shares are burned at the vault's price.

findings.title: withdraw: the amount paid out is the vault's balance change after the connector runs, which may differ from `assets`.
findings.evidence: Vault._withdraw: safeTransfer(asset, receiver, balanceOf(this) - _balanceBefore) after delegatecalling the connector's withdraw. The connector source is not in the directory. The label reads 'Withdraw exactly'.
findings.fix: You could use the label 'Withdraw', since the code doesn't guarantee an exact amount.

findings.title: withdraw: intent "Withdraw" with no interpolatedIntent names neither the asset nor the vault.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` kmgpUSDT from `owner`. If the owner is not the signer, this spends the owner's allowance.
Sends USDT to `receiver`. The vault computes the amount from the share price after the reward fee, and nothing in calldata sets a minimum.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem", the shares to redeem in kmgpUSDT, the recipient and the owner. No field names the asset received.

findings.title: redeem: no field names USDT as the asset the signer receives.
findings.evidence: Vault._withdraw: safeTransfer(IERC20(asset()), receiver, ...). The redeem fields are only shares, receiver and owner. Case 1: the signer received 1019432 USDT, and the reader wrote "Which token is paid out; screen doesn't say".
findings.fix: Add a field {"label":"Receive asset","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker","format":"raw"} as mint does, and/or an interpolatedIntent "Redeem {shares} for USDT".

findings.title: redeem: the USDT amount received is computed by the contract, with no minimum in calldata.
findings.evidence: Vault.redeem: _assets = _convertToAssets(shares, Math.Rounding.Floor, _newTotalAssets, _newTotalSupply). Case 1: 1019432 USDT went in to the signer and the screen shows no amount.

cases.notes: The reader got the shares burned right. For the USDT received, the reader guessed USDT and did not know the amount.
